purpose: Security, cryptography, secret-handling, IPC trust and encrypted-sync validation

cases.scenario: Local secret protected by Windows user boundary
cases.userFriction: Security should be invisible during ordinary use; users should not have to manage raw key files.

cases.scenario: OAuth token never enters usage database
cases.userFriction: Account credentials must never unexpectedly appear in history exports or diagnostics.
No direct user interaction; failure is a catastrophic integrity/security defect.
Tampered cloud data should fail safely without damaging local history.

cases.scenario: Wrong dataset or epoch cannot decrypt object
cases.userFriction: Cross-account or cross-dataset mistakes must not surface as corrupted user history.
Recovery should be trustworthy without exposing sensitive material in support artifacts.
Users should not see prompts or breakage when a malicious client is simply denied.

cases.scenario: Private-browser identity is blocked at all boundaries
cases.userFriction: The privacy promise must survive fallbacks and internal pipelines, not merely the UI.

cases.scenario: Replay of stale remote generation rejected
cases.userFriction: A previously valid cloud state should never silently roll back newer history.
Privacy-sensitive users should not need to trust a hidden analytics switch; behavior should match the promise.
